metadata.title: Mustafa Özdemir · Flutter Developer
metadata.description: Flutter developer building mobile apps, with Go and Next.js on the side.

hero.title: I build mobile apps for iOS and Android with Flutter.
hero.summary: Mostly Flutter and Dart. When a project needs a backend or a web front, I reach for Go and Next.js.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I studied IT and spent years on the hardware and systems side of the industry: technical support, IT operations and CRM. Then I decided to grow into software and completed a 300-hour Flutter program. Today I work as a Flutter developer at Ufuk Araç Takip Sistemi, a vehicle tracking company.
Alongside mobile, I work with Go and Next.js on the backend and web side. I like simple interfaces, readable code, and seeing a feature through from start to finish.
